entry.codeblock:
Document Approval Workflow

Documents progress through several stages before they are approved for publication. The following workflow illustrates the overall approval lifecycle.

  1. Authoring
    1. Draft creation
    2. Initial self-review
  2. Review
    1. Technical review
    2. Editorial review

section.p: Result: Two-level numbered lists are preserved in <conbody> as a second <ol>block nested inside the parent <ol> block.
